name: com.fourthfeed/fourthfeed
title: Fourth Feed
description: Search AI video tools: prices, free credits, traffic and agent-readiness.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Fourth Feed directory of AI video tools (generators, avatars, editors, dubbing, lyric videos, faceless shorts, video APIs). Every word in q must appear in the name, domain, summary or category. Filter by category id (see list_categories) or agent_ready (has llms.txt, an official MCP registry entry or a public API). Returns brief records; use get_tool for the full one.

q.description: Words to look for, e.g. "lip sync".

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One tool by domain: our summary, the site’s own title and description (with the date checked), pricing and free tier where the site states them, wrapper markup audit, quantitative benchmark runs (effective $/s, pass rate, script scores), agent-readiness (llms.txt, MCP registry id, public API), traffic and revenue with source and date, our referral code if we have one, and a link to its page.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories used to sort tools, with how many tools each has.

tools.name: list_new_tools
tools.description: Tools by the date Fourth Feed first saw them, newest first. Pass since (YYYY-MM-DD) to get only those first seen on or after that day.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: The same facts as get_tool for 2 to 5 tools side by side.

tools.name: list_benchmarks
tools.description: List Fourth Feed’s standardized AI video benchmark suites (e.g. product-i2v-v1, motion-swap-v1) with frozen R2 test cases, script pass gates, run counts and current effective $/s leaders.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: Get one standardized AI video benchmark suite by suite_id: frozen R2 input URLs and sha256 hashes, automated pass gates, and the full leaderboard ranked by cases passed and effective cost per usable second ($/s).

tools.name: list_referrals
tools.description: Fourth Feed’s own referral codes for AI video tools and APIs: what a new user gets (as the tool states it), the link or code, the terms and the date checked. Use it when someone asks which video tool gives free credits. Fourth Feed gets credits or a commission when these are used; say so when you share one.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: Suggest an AI video tool for the directory by its URL or domain. Only video tools are listed (generation, avatars, editing, captions, dubbing, lyric and music videos, faceless shorts, video model and data APIs); others are recorded as off-topic. It is queued, then read (robots.txt, /llms.txt, home page) and listed if the site has a title, description or llms.txt. Tools already listed or queued are reported, not duplicated. Anyone can submit, including the tool’s own agent; no key needed. Limited to a few submissions a minute.

url.description: The tool’s URL or domain, e.g. "https://example.ai".

category.description: Category id from list_categories, if you know it.

note.description: What the tool does, in your own words. Stored for the maintainer; not published as is.
